senses.gloss: f. (b. h.) m’surah, a measure of capacity, one thirty-sixth of a Log.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 61b:5">B. Mets. 61ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 89b:9">B. Bath. 89ᵇ</cite>.—Sifra K’dosh. Par. 3, ch. VIII <he>במ׳ זו זיר הגדול</he> ‘in measure’ (<cite ref="Leviticus 19:35">Lev. XIX, 35</cite>) that means you must leave a large crest (in dry measure), v. <cite ref="G00416"><he>זֵיר</he></cite>.
